item.title: Road closures and power outages reported in Baton Rouge, surrounding areas due to heavy rain
item.description: Heavy rainfall in Baton Rouge has caused multiple road closures, power outages, and vehicle stalls, with several areas experiencing high water.

item.title: New Orleans airport experiencing delays due to partial government shutdown
item.description: The Louis Armstrong International Airport is experiencing delays Sunday, March 8.

item.title: Crawfête 2026: Food festival returns to Baton Rouge with crawfish, local restaurants and live music
item.description: Crawfête, a crawfish festival in Baton Rouge, supports childhood nutrition programs. Enjoy crawfish, local restaurant tastings, and live music.

item.title: Crack cocaine, stolen guns found in Baton Rouge drug bust
item.description: Baton Rouge police arrest man after finding drugs, cash, and stolen guns during a search at a home. Investigation ongoing.

item.title: Soldier becomes seventh US service member killed during Operation Epic Fury
item.description: The service member was injured earlier this month, according to authorities.

item.title: Floods close roads, alter parking for LSU baseball game
item.description: LSU is advising fans to use caution when traveling to Alex Box Stadium for Sunday's baseball game due to flooding, and to use alternate routes and parking lots as some roads and lots will be closed.

item.title: This Week in Louisiana Politics: Mifepristone pill, FastSites, and the upcoming legislative session
item.description: Louisiana is seeking a preliminary injunction to halt the distribution of abortion pills through telehealth services, which could have a nationwide impact on medical providers and patients, while the state is also implementing the Fast Sites program to accelerate industrial development and lawmakers are focusing on key issues such as school vouchers and carbon capture regulations.

item.title: Crash shuts down I-12 eastbound near Satsuma Road exit
item.description: A portion of I-12 eastbound near the Satsuma Road exit in Baton Rouge, Louisiana has been shut down due to a crash, and motorists are advised to use caution and find an alternative route if possible.
